behavior: List, open, create, rename, archive and delete canonical conversations through authenticated backend APIs.
Reconstruct all bounded active transcript pages with version fencing; browser transcript is never sent as model history.
Submit new turns using stable idempotency keys and exact registered provider/model selection; follow accepted work without resubmitting it.
Parse SSE incrementally across UTF-8, newline and event boundaries; reconnect using the last accepted engine sequence in Last-Event-ID.
Treat engine output as provisional; replace it with the canonical assistant message only after chat.final or authoritative terminal probe.
Transport abort detaches observation. Explicit cancellation invokes the durable backend cancel API and follows terminal settlement.
Reject malformed, foreign-thread, conflicting duplicate or out-of-order event identities; recover through canonical turn status and conversation snapshots.
Keep only tenant-scoped conversation, pending-turn and cursor metadata on device; transcripts and attachment bytes are not persisted by this client.
Expose loading, reconnecting, cancellation, structured error and retry states through one observable conversation controller.
Edits resend the exact canonical edited user message using its stable edit key; no duplicate user message is appended.
Regeneration uses a frozen server request, deferred admission, actual status, explicit cancellation and exact stored-command resume; another device discovers bounded canonical request references.

Authorized JSON and Markdown exports are rendered by the server after live governance admission. The client verifies exact thread/version/scope and SHA256 before download; it never synthesizes an offline export.
Account changes abort observation and clear displayed private data. Additional headers cannot substitute an unverified identity, and sensitive export returns are fenced against account changes.
Provider attempt reset/started events discard previous provisional output. Normal stream expiration reconnects without resending accepted work.

App restart replays from cursor zero to reconstruct actual provisional deltas; device storage contains no transcript bytes. High-frequency cursor writes are coalesced into one in-flight write and one latest metadata value.
failure_behavior: Fail closed with typed authorization, conflict, unavailable, protocol, cancelled or network error. Recovery reads canonical state; no mock response or local provider fallback.
validation_policy: User explicitly requested this implementation window contain no added or executed tests. Static type and source checks may be used; runtime qualification remains pending.
